notes.title: Announcing Another Game With Climbing Mechanics!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35730242/72d3938b5dfda93f4ace50552070e9f8a3547e67.png[/img]
Not many people may know this, but Hatch was originally a much more ambitious project. I had to scope it down to meet my skill level at the time as a developer.

Now I finally have gained the XP to tackle the project as I originally envisioned!

[b]Lorn's Lure[/b] is a spiritual successor to Hatch. A more detailed and refined poem. More challenging too!

[b]Set to release (preliminarily) in April 2021[/b]

An android is led through a vast structure by a glitch in his visual system. Lorn's Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climbing mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.

[h3][b]WISHLIST NOW![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1417930/Lorns_Lure/

notes.title: Progress Is Now Saved After Quitting!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I've added a much-requested feature: SAVING!

Hatch now saves automatically at checkpoints, and respawns you when starting the game anew and pressing "Enter".

You can clear your saves at the start menu by pressing "c".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35730242/e865edbd86eafff4c9705858f0b6a56a2a49db59.png[/img]

Hopefully this will help everyone reach the top over time :)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Major Climbing Mechanics Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This update addresses the following issues raised by the community:

- slow climbing / cannot climb a steep wall unless you hop up
- if get caught in the sun, no fast way down
- can easily shoot yourself off the sides of a narrow wall due to poor running mechanics
- that feeling that it's not your fault that you can't make a jump

The changes are still not perfect, but should adequately address the above problems with the following new movement mechanics:

- climb walls without hopping (although you can hop more crisply to speed up)
- can walk left, right, and down walls (but not too steep an angle down)
- generous fall-off-ledge jumping
- running is the default, press shift to walk
- jumping is tighter in general

I've also added a dot cursor to help those with motion sickness.

Please let me know if there are any bugs, i'll improve the mechanics if necessary :)

Below is a video summarizing the update. Hope you enjoy!

[previewyoutube=HXXS9icWUy0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
